iclonepy.note: Embedded Python with RLPy SWIG bindings; requires iClone 8 running for live API access

cc5py.note: Embedded Python with RLPy SWIG bindings; requires CC5 running for live API access

note: RLPy is a SWIG-generated Python binding to Reallusion's C++ API. Scripts run inside the host app's embedded interpreter via iClonepy.exe or CharacterCreatorpy.exe. Headless/async workflows require the host app to be running and accepting socket/script commands.
